purpose: Family-level preflight rollout registry for first-party svc skills.
rules: Every included skill must be covered exactly once by a family unless it has a direct ## Preflight section.
Family coverage is a blocking rollout contract, not a substitute for skill-specific checks when a skill has unusual inputs or outputs.
Hook enforcement remains fail-open for missing contracts and fail-closed for declared .svc/preflight-<skill>.json contracts on first-party hosts.

families.input_policy: Resolve the target product artifact from project state, work item, or the spec index before writing.
families.output_policy: Check intended docs/specs outputs are writable before producing durable artifacts.

families.input_policy: Validate the active spec/plan/task graph before action; for implementation, verify worktree and declared evidence paths.
families.output_policy: Check code, evidence, and lane-task outputs before editing or claiming completion.

families.input_policy: Resolve the bounded target through session contract, work-item index, and related specs before routing or diagnosing.
families.output_policy: Check state, decision-log, work-item, and advice artifacts before writing durable changes.

families.input_policy: Identify the affected framework surface and validator before editing skills, hooks, manifests, or rules.
families.output_policy: Check manifest, docs, hook, and tier-1 validator outputs before claiming the framework change is closed.

families.input_policy: Resolve the domain/tooling surface and relevant knowledge index before recommendations or generated assets.
families.output_policy: Check generated docs, images, benchmarks, and capability artifacts are writable and evidence-backed.
